en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a mountainous, forested landscape. In the foreground, three people sit or recline on a grassy meadow looking toward densely wooded hills and higher rocky peaks in the background. The photo is mounted on a card with wide margins. On the front margin, handwritten text reads a date and location. The reverse side has the typical divided-back postcard layout printed with vertical dotted address lines and the small word "Agfa" at the center.
